address: Plas Dinas Country House, Bontnewydd, LL54 7YF, United Kingdom
bio: Formerly home to Lord Snowdon, the cosy Plas Dinas Country House dates from the 17C, and was built around the stone fireplace that still stands in The Gunroom today. Come for afternoon tea or for dinner at either 6 or 8pm. Welsh produce takes the lead on the concise, classically based monthly menu.
